signature.name: Amman Citadel
signature.detail: The hilltop site where Amman's history layers from Roman to Umayyad times, with the Temple of Hercules columns and the Umayyad palace remains. It is the city's defining sight and gives wide views over downtown. Go early morning or late afternoon for cooler weather and better light; it is a short taxi ride from downtown.

signature.name: Roman Theater
signature.detail: A well-preserved 2nd-century Roman theater cut into the hillside, still used for performances. Its scale and setting make it a must-see for first-time visitors. Visit in the morning to avoid the midday heat; it is a short walk from downtown and the Citadel.

transport: Taxis and ride-hailing short trips $2-5; little usable public transit
